CustomObject.description:
When a lead is converted to an opportunity and the business expert (picklist field) is referenced, the appropriate user needs to be added to the opportunity team member list.
In order to accomplish this functionality, we had to create this custom metadata type and populated with the respective users' Names along with their UserdID, Region and their secteur(Secteur = Business Expert value: Healthcare, Retail, Industry .....)
Example when a lead is converted to an opportunity, the business expert value is equal to Retail and the owner country code is equal to France, (as of Friday 03/06/2020) Fernando DESOUSA must be added to the opportunity team member list
Important Note: UserId changes from one org to another ( from sandbox to production ONLY). So make sure to update the userId when deploying this metaDataType to production.
CustomObject.label: Subject mater expert Director
